subject: Spin box on shiny for large files load before calling shinyServer

messages.author: 37283d7785922c0c
messages.subject: Spin box on shiny for large files load before calling shinyServer
parts:
Hi all,
have a quick question on displaying some sort of indicator on data loading, but on data that is loaded before shinyServer is called (I guess that's between shiny:connectedand shiny:sessioninitialized events.

Currently I use this for shiny busy:

SpinBox <- function(){
  tagList(
    conditionalPanel(condition="$('html').hasClass('shiny-busy')",
                     absolutePanel(top="25%", left ="25%",
                                   wellPanel(style="background-color:green; color:white",
                                             draggable = TRUE,icon("refresh fa-spin fa-2x", lib="font-awesome"),
                                             "Loading..."
                                   )
                     )
    )
  )
}

but obviously that will not work when the "busy" happens before shinyServer is called. What I'm looking for some help on is how to write something equivalent for this case:

# ------------

data <- readRDS("LargeMatrix.rds")

# some magical js that will somehow indicate the user that things are going on, most likely triggered by an event?

shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {.....})



Thanks in advance!
